description.en: The objects that you want to add.

description.zh:
文件的存储位置。

OSS地址规则为oss://${Bucket}/${Object}，其中`${Bucket}`为和当前项目处于同一区域(Region)的OSS Bucket名称，`${Object}`为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径。
description.en:
The URI of the object.

Specify the OSS URI in the oss://${Bucket}/${Object} format, where `${Bucket}` is the name of the bucket in the same region as the current project and `${Object}` is the path of the object with the extension included.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun imm add-story-files --project-name test-project --dataset-name test-dataset --object-id testid --files URI=oss://test-bucket/test-object --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
